All three round-2 defects are resolved, and the way [2.1] was fixed is the right way.

## [2.1] — fixed, and not on my say-so

The worker wrote its own probe (`tie_check.py`) rather than taking my word for it, and reproduced my measurement exactly: 216/216 source rows all-zero, **0/216 fully tied**, median 20 distinct of 21, spread 2.117/3.676/5.328, cold hit@1 0.0880, MRR 0.2274 vs chance 0.1736, tiebreak vector byte-identical across calls.

It also surfaced a detail I had missed — **124/216 queries have *partial* ties** (min 14 distinct) — and the answer now says "fully tied", which is the precise claim rather than the convenient one.

The paragraph now states the correct mechanism (with `u=0`, `|u−v|→|v|` and `‖u−v‖→‖v‖`, so ranking runs on candidate-only features) and calls the floor "a weak popularity prior, not chance." Re-anchored on the measured control and verified by me at full precision: 4.480→**4.5×**, 3.519→**3.5×**, gaps 10.30 and 7.45→**10.3** and **7.5 sd**. Follow-through is complete — the density paragraph, the conclusion, and the "chance (1/21)" line in both figures (confirmed gone by extracting the PDF text).

## [2.2], [2.3] — fixed

`float` removed, and the worker went further by dropping `caption` and `amssymb` too. I checked that rather than assuming: no amssymb-only macros in the fragment, and my wrapper compiles clean on the reduced 5-package preamble. `submission.md` now opens with the retraction and explicitly withdraws the old confidence item.

## Nothing regressed

Mechanically re-checked `answer.tex` against the raw pickles: **all 112 Table 1 cells match**, all 8 bolded cells are the true argmax, the noise-floor row matches, and **all 48 Table 2 cells plus all 12 bolded cells match** — including the 8–15 row where H@1 and MRR bold different columns. Result pickles are untouched since earlier rounds, so nothing was silently re-run. Compile rc=0, 6 pages (length held), 0 overfull/underfull, 0 undefined. Lint clean, R5 clean, figures vector and legible.

Across three rounds every reported number has been reproduced from the raw pickles through an independent code path, the sampler verified against the spec on the real graph, the corpus measurement confirmed twice, and the one false mechanistic claim measured false and corrected.

VERDICT: PASS
